title: Toolbox Theme Manager 2.1.0
description: Install, remove, customise and import Perspective gateway themes. Carries 10 (glass-violet, glass-green, leather-dark, leather-light, finance-ledger, newsprint-dark, nord-dark, nord-light, industrial-dark, industrial-light); installs all or any of them, and imports a theme zip from someone else after checking it. Writes gateway config resources under com.inductiveautomation.perspective/themes/ and runs a config scan, no restart. · v2.1.0
